metric_definitions.resolution_success_rate: cases meeting verified connectivity goal / all cases
metric_definitions.valid_action_rate: valid executed actions / all executed actions
metric_definitions.average_action_cost_per_case: sum of action costs / all cases, including zero-action cases
metric_definitions.verification_accuracy: terminal verification matching evaluator ground truth / all cases

evidence_note: Each JSONL record retains the exact case input, full raw result, and execution trace.
